clue.text: Not sharing one's home?

parts.note: someone who shares a home with nobody else has a dwelling that is theirs alone, phrased as a question to hint at the cryptic reading

explanation.surface: A question about someone who lives without housemates.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes personal accommodation that is not shared, exactly the circumstance of not sharing a home.

clue.text: Quiet goat be disturbed in the marshy area

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning quiet

indicators.note: letters that are disturbed are thrown out of order, so the words goat be are rearranged

explanation.surface: A goat is told to keep quiet while unsettled out on the marshes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges GOAT BE into EATBOG, which follows P.
explanation.definitionFit: A bog of decayed vegetation is a wet, swampy stretch of ground.

clue.text: Where one goes may be determined by accident

definitions.text: Where one goes may be determined by accident

parts.words: Where one goes may be determined by accident
parts.note: reads like a remark about chance and fate, but describes a paramedic driver whose destination is set by the scene of a crash

explanation.surface: A philosophical musing that chance decides our path in life.
explanation.definitionFit: Emergency vehicle drivers are sent wherever a crash or injury has happened.

clue.text: Gain by Labour

parts.note: suggests an electoral win for the British Labour Party, but means acquiring money through work

explanation.surface: A news headline about the Labour Party winning a seat.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital L makes Labour look like the UK political party; read it as plain work.
explanation.definitionFit: To receive wages or reward in return for work done.

clue.text: A very black insect going round lacking vitality

indicators.note: the insect word goes round, encircling the other pieces placed inside it

parts.note: a fly is an insect
BB is the pencil grade for very black (soft) lead

explanation.surface: A dark bug circles about, looking listless.
explanation.walkthrough: BB on pencils marks a very soft, dark lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Something soft and slack has no firmness or energy.

clue.text: Found in cigarettes, not nice, I unravelled

indicators.note: something unravelled has been undone and comes apart, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone, not enjoying it, picks apart a cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: The addictive alkaloid present in tobacco smoked as cigarettes.

clue.text: Nothing more than a religious rite in California

indicators.note: the zero piece is added on, over and above the rite

parts.note: a sacrament such as baptism or communion is a religious rite
O, the figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: Merely a church ceremony held in California.
explanation.definitionFit: The state capital of California, so a city located in that state.

clue.text: Proof that it has been put down

definitions.text: Proof that it has been put down

parts.words: Proof that it has been put down
parts.note: sounds like evidence an animal was destroyed, but means proof recorded on paper

explanation.surface: Confirmation that a pet has been put to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Documentation set out on paper and used to establish facts.

clue.text: Official baled out with energy

indicators.note: out here means wrong or disordered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An official bales out with plenty of vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges BALED into BEADL, before E.
explanation.definitionFit: A parish or ceremonial officer, especially in a church or college.

clue.text: Former prince taking a province

parts.note: Prince Albert, consort of Queen Victoria, is a prince of the past

explanation.surface: A one-time royal annexes a region.
explanation.definitionFit: A Canadian province, named after one of Queen Victoria's daughters.

clue.text: I can produce, in company, Oriental drug

indicators.note: to produce is to make something new, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: E for eastern, oriental meaning from the East

explanation.surface: A firm boasts it can manufacture an Eastern narcotic.
explanation.definitionFit: A stimulant extracted from coca leaves, used illegally as a narcotic.

clue.text: Make a dash for a security device

definitions.meaning: a sliding bar that fastens a door

explanation.definitionFit: Running off suddenly, and also the metal bar that locks a door.

clue.text: Not applied by editor being absent-minded

parts.note: abstract art or science is theoretical, not applied

explanation.surface: An editor's theory pieces leave them distracted.
explanation.definitionFit: Lost in thought and inattentive, a synonym of preoccupied.

clue.text: Having extended across first free site

parts.note: best means first, top of the list
to rid is to free of something
a den is a site, a lair or haunt

explanation.surface: A sprawling first free campsite.
explanation.definitionFit: Past participle of straddling, standing or sitting with legs either side.

clue.text: Bird moves out of danger

indicators.note: the letters move out of their order in the given word, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A bird escapes from peril.
explanation.definitionFit: A male goose, a kind of waterfowl.

clue.text: I want no end to confine a sea-bird, one has been confined

indicators.note: the trimmed word encloses the bird, holding it within
the last letter of the word for want is removed

parts.note: to need is to want
a tern is a sea-bird

explanation.surface: Someone eager to keep a gull caged indefinitely.
explanation.walkthrough: NEED loses its last letter to NEE, which holds TERN, after I.
explanation.definitionFit: A detainee held in camp, typically in wartime.

clue.text: Four twice ruffling fussy decoration

indicators.note: the rearranged group appears two times in a row
ruffling disturbs the order, so the word Four is rearranged

explanation.surface: Four lots of fluffy frills on an outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruffling' rearranges FOUR into FROU, which 'twice' repeats.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaborate frills or ornament, especially on clothing.

clue.text: Animal, carnivore about to be caught by the river

indicators.note: the river comes next to the rest
the word for about is held within the carnivore

parts.note: a cat is a meat-eating animal
RE means about or concerning
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A predator, about to be captured at the waterside.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ure is a river in North Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Any living being, especially a beast.

clue.text: Rex leaves another picture of the match

indicators.note: the letter for king departs from the word picture
another arrangement of the remaining letters signals rearranging

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: With the king gone, a fresh photo of the game.
explanation.walkthrough: PICTURE less R gives PICTUE, which 'another' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A knockout game in a trophy competition, such as football.

clue.text: Strive to convert an old Dutch coin

indicators.note: converting changes form, so the letters of strive are rearranged

explanation.surface: Trying to change some historic Netherlands money.
explanation.definitionFit: A small coin once used in the Netherlands, worth a trifling amount.

clue.text: A clergyman outside the nuclear device

indicators.note: the clergyman stands outside the single letter, enclosing it

parts.note: a rector is a parish clergyman

explanation.surface: A vicar standing outside the atomic plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparatus in which a controlled chain reaction occurs.

clue.text: Jewish leader has little time for the small creature

parts.note: a rabbi is a Jewish religious leader
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A rabbi is too busy to bother with a tiny animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A burrowing mammal with long ears.

clue.text: Fussy detail

explanation.definitionFit: Hard to please, and also a single specific item or point.

clue.text: Less than perfect plan

indicators.note: the word for perfect falls short, losing its final letter

parts.note: ideal means perfect

explanation.surface: A scheme that is not quite flawless.
explanation.definitionFit: A thought or scheme in mind.

clue.text: Not a complete case of cheese

indicators.note: the word for case is incomplete, its last letter cut off

parts.note: a brief is a legal case

explanation.surface: A box of cheese that is not full.
explanation.walkthrough: A barrister's brief is the case they argue.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft French cheese with a white rind.

clue.text: Raven I'd entangled, it had entered by force

indicators.note: something entangled is twisted up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A raven gets caught up, having forced its way in.
explanation.definitionFit: An attacker who intrudes forcibly into territory.

clue.text: He's entitled to exclude note that's rewritten

parts.note: to bar is to exclude

indicators.note: a word that is rewritten is set down in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone refuses a memo that has been redrafted.
explanation.definitionFit: A hereditary titled rank below a baron, so a holder of a title.

clue.text: Educate at that place a revolutionary leader who will come last

parts.note: to bring up is to raise and educate
there means at that place

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Raise there a rebel chief destined to trail behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To be at the back of a group or procession.
